items.name: Piste
items.details: Daim bleu glacier, lacets crème et semelle fine couleur miel.
items.design: Slim low-profile 1970s track sneaker, ice blue brushed suede, fine cream laces, short rounded toe with wraparound T-toe stitch and thin honey gum sole. No stripes or trademarks.

items.name: Rafale
items.details: Mesh gris perle, renforts argentés et semelle sculptée.
items.design: Pearl grey ventilated mesh tech runner with restrained satin-silver curved overlays, white round laces and a sculpted white-and-charcoal segmented running sole. Athletic but fitted with a clear toe box, no brand insignia.

items.name: Relevé
items.details: Satin rose poudré, brides élastiques croisées et semelle souple.
items.design: Ballet-sneaker hybrid in dusty ballet pink matte satin with crossed narrow elastic straps over the instep, low-cut rounded ballet toe with piping, and a thin blush rubber athletic outsole. No laces, no decorative bow.

items.name: Campus
items.details: Cuir écru, empiècements vert sapin et semelle cousue.
items.design: Classic low-top tennis court sneaker in cream grained leather, forest-green suede toe bumper and eyelet stay, off-white cupsole with precise stitch line and discreet toe perforations; a clearly original panel design. No trademark.

items.name: Silex
items.details: Cuir noir mat, élastiques ton sur ton et semelle crantée.
items.design: Black matte leather Chelsea ankle boot with a rounded toe, low stacked heel, defined compact lug sole and a glimpse of tonal elastic side gusset. Shaft reaches the trouser cuff, no laces, no hardware.

items.name: Dune
items.details: Daim taupe, tige souple et bout amande.
items.prompt: Use the attached Iris front fitting artwork as exact character, pose, full head to toe composition and background. ONLY replace the two shoes with this matching pair: A soft taupe mushroom suede ankle boot, rounded almond toe, close ankle shaft with one natural gentle fold at ankle, a narrow tonal pull tab on the outer side of each ankle, low honey-stained stacked heel and very fine welt. Distinctly refined slouch ankle boot, not cowboy, no western stitching, no pointy toe, no straps, no laces. Premium suede nap. This is a replacement design for a fashion game capsule. Keep the same black cropped trousers, ivory cropped top, frontal stance, hand positions, leg and foot centers, proportions, skin, face and neutral gray background. Draw both boots symmetrically, aligned with existing feet, maintaining the floor. Let each shaft meet the trouser hem without leaving bare skin below it. Footwear details and grain are hand painted, premium polished illustration with restrained lighting, suitable for Un petit monde's Prune fumée art. Strict front view, no side views, no visible zips on the front, no logos, no outside objects or text. Prefer the exact 887 × 1774 framing, preserve full soles.

items.name: Étrier
items.details: Cuir olive, bride fine et boucle en laiton vieilli.
items.prompt: Edit the two shoes only in this exact front-facing Un petit monde Iris fitting image. New original matching ankle boots called Étrier: refined dark olive leather with a subtly waxed satin finish, rounded almond toes, a fine strap laid horizontally across each ankle with a small antique-brass stirrup-shaped buckle positioned on the outer side and visible from the front. Low stable dark stacked heel, trim sole, close-fitting ankle shafts tucked cleanly under the cropped trousers. A modern neat equestrian ankle boot, not an ivory dress boot, not a cowboy shape, not a chunky Chelsea, no laces, no logo. Keep exact Iris mannequin, full front pose, gray background, top, cropped trousers and height, exact foot placement and complete soles, premium hand-painted fashion illustration. Show both boots clearly front-facing on both feet. Maintain native 887 × 1774 framing if possible. No other objects.

items.name: Virgule
items.details: Cuir grenat, bout pointu et décolleté en V.
items.design: Garnet red classic point-toe leather pump with a clean V-shaped vamp and restrained patent sheen, medium-high thin heel. Bare instep, no strap, no hardware, elegantly close fitting.

items.name: Opaline
items.details: Cuir ivoire, bout noir et bride arrière fine.
items.design: Refined ivory slingback low kitten heel with a crisp black cap toe in soft almond shape, narrow ivory back strap visible where the design allows around the sides of the foot, no ankle strap, smooth matte leather and one subtle side buckle only if visible from the actual front.

items.name: Agrafe
items.details: Cuir noir verni, bout rond et fine bride à boucle dorée.
items.design: Timeless polished black leather Mary Jane pump with a rounded-square toe, one thin instep strap with a small brushed brass buckle on the outer side and a low rectangular block heel. Plain black leather, no platform.

prompt: Use the supplied Un petit monde illustration as the exact native 887 × 1774 canvas. Edit only the existing shoes and the pixels that they cover. Create a matching pair of original shoes worn by Iris: [DESIGN] Keep Iris exactly the same front-facing mannequin: head, expression, identity, caraco, trousers, body proportions, leg spacing, feet centers and front-view silhouette. Do not change the pose to show the side, do not make her pigeon-toed, do not alter leg length or floor height, and preserve the plain cool grey background and full head-to-toe crop. For sneakers, allow the natural low toe silhouette to replace the high-heel pointed toe, with the soles on the same ground. Fit both shoes symmetrically to the two existing feet, no cut off soles or toes, no toe or skin spilling through closed shoes, and no socks. Ankle boots may overlap the visible ankle up to the existing trouser hems without altering trousers. Keep true front view even if the heel itself is partially hidden. Draw clean hand-painted fashion game linework and subtle material shading, fine leather, suede and textile grain as appropriate; premium Prune fumée reference level, no photorealism or vector. No labels, logos, additional views or objects.
